Vignette.title: Vignette & Tourist Tax
Vignette.intro: Work out what your vignette (cruising permit) and tourist tax will cost before you arrive.
Vignette.sourceNote: The vignette fee comes from Article 28 of the Law on Yachts, and the tourist tax from the Decree on Tourist Tax for Nautical Tourism Vessels. You can download both from the <laws>Laws</laws> tab. The Harbour Master's office confirms the final amount when you buy the vignette.

Contractors.title: Contractors
Contractors.intro: Local contractors for yachts in Montenegro, from engine servicing to provisioning and help ashore. Pick a category, then call or email them directly.
Contractors.marinaNote: Berthed in a marina? Check with the marina office before a contractor starts work on board. Some marinas, Porto Montenegro among them, require contractors to announce their work in advance.
Contractors.listingNote: Run a yacht service in Montenegro, or spotted outdated details? <contact>Get in touch</contact>.
